# Paths that live on dev but must never reach main.
#
# main is what Vercel builds and deploys, so it should carry the site and
# nothing else. Everything here is working material: the tools we run by hand
# and the before/after media we attach to PRs.
#
# Single source of truth. Both of these read it:
#   scripts/release-to-main.mjs           strips these paths from a release
#   .github/workflows/main-stays-clean.yml  fails main if one shows up
#
# One path per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored. A trailing slash
# means the whole directory.
#
# Deleting PR media from main does not break the raw links in PR bodies: those
# point at commit SHAs, and the blobs stay in history forever.

scripts/
docs/
